steps.speaker: Maimed Figure
steps.content: Even so, I...

The illusory realm surrounds Hecate. Before her, ${PlayerName} is fighting the contaminated mascots alone, the power draining his spirit. He falls down time and time again, and gets back up each time.
steps.female_content: The illusory realm surrounds Hecate. Before her, ${PlayerName} is fighting the contaminated mascots alone, the power draining her spirit. She falls down time and time again, and gets back up each time.

steps.content: Hecate is watching this blankly, a blurred illusion standing next to her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I know this is all just an illusion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You're making me see this so I'll feel the same pain you're feeling. But this is pointless, I don't feel any pain.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Release me, protecting Chief is my duty. That's the meaning of my existence.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: I don't cause pain in others, I only rouse their emotions.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I've given up all my emotions long ago. I'll say this once more, release me.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: If you had really given them up, you wouldn't have been here. You chose to stay...
The illusion begins transforming, eventually turning into a duplicate of herself.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief needed to go into the Black Ring, you were supposed to follow him everywhere. His orders are the sole meaning of your existence.
steps.female_content: Chief needed to go into the Black Ring, you were supposed to follow her everywhere. Her orders are the sole meaning of your existence.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But you doubted his orders and didn't catch up with him. You halted your steps and stayed still. That was why he had no choice but to go on alone, getting trapped in danger all by himself.
steps.female_content: But you doubted her orders and didn't catch up with her. You halted your steps and stayed still. That was why she had no choice but to go on alone, getting trapped in danger all by herself.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't you want to protect him? Are you doubting him?
steps.female_content: Don't you want to protect her? Are you doubting her?

steps.content: Hecate doesn't answer. Meanwhile, another illusion tugs at her sleeve.
Hecate turns back and sees a scrawny girl in lab garb who's trembling fretfully.
...That's her too, herself a few years ago.

steps.speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
steps.content: No... No... I didn't doubt the order. I wanted to protect him, even at the cost of my own life, I wanted to protect him.
steps.female_content: No... No... I didn't doubt the order. I wanted to protect her, even at the cost of my own life, I wanted to protect her.

steps.speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
steps.content: But I already knew... If he entered the Black Ring, I wouldn't be able to protect him... Like last time, I couldn't protect him from harm. It's happening again... now.
steps.female_content: But I already knew... If she entered the Black Ring, I wouldn't be able to protect her... Like last time, I couldn't protect her from harm. It's happening again... now.

steps.content: She sees ${PlayerName} fall down again in the illusion and begins trembling all over.

steps.speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
steps.content: Protecting him is the meaning of my existence, but I'm too weak, this is the only thing I can do. I'm sorry...
steps.female_content: Protecting her is the meaning of my existence, but I'm too weak, this is the only thing I can do. I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Because you halted your steps, he had to go into danger alone.
steps.female_content: Because you halted your steps, she had to go into danger alone.

steps.speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
steps.content: If I can stop him, he won't face danger.
steps.female_content: If I can stop her, she won't face danger.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's a judgment uncalled for, you only have to follow the orders.

steps.speaker: Phantom of Young Hecate
steps.content: Protecting him from harm is an order too... Which order should I follow?
steps.female_content: Protecting her from harm is an order too... Which order should I follow?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I can't decide. I don't know what's the right thing to do. I need to protect him, but no one is giving me the correct order.
steps.female_content: I can't decide. I don't know what's the right thing to do. I need to protect her, but no one is giving me the correct order.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But what does this have to do with you? No matter how troubled I am, it's all for the orders, I don't have any emotions you can stir.
The Misery Puppet's voice comes from the void.

steps.speaker: Hollow Voice
steps.content: You're wrong. The old you would only obey the order given to you at any moment. If you receive contradictory orders, you would stop your action and wait for the higher-ups to give you a modified, feasible order.

steps.speaker: Hollow Voice
steps.content: But now you're hesitating and struggling.

steps.speaker: Hollow Voice
steps.content: You want to understand his decision and share his pain. You want to stay by his side and support him, but you're worried for him and scared of seeing him get hurt. You're anxious about your incompetence and weakness, eager to find the correct answer.
steps.female_content: You want to understand her decision and share her pain. You want to stay by her side and support her, but you're worried for her and scared of seeing her get hurt. You're anxious about your incompetence and weakness, eager to find the correct answer.

steps.speaker: Hollow Voice
steps.content: These feelings don't come with orders. To you, they're too much, too complex, you who've forgone your emotions have long lost the ability to process them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You mean to say... that surgery didn't work...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Unnecessary emotions have cropped up within me again, they're hindering me and making me useless...?
Her heart feels like it's been ripped open. She finally realizes she's never lifted her gaze. She's been watching ${PlayerName} get hurt and fall down again and again.
She feels pain.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is no good... This is wrong... I shouldn't waver, I can't hesitate...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Help me, if anything unnecessary has reemerged, help me get rid of it again. I must execute the orders, I can't be trapped here.

steps.speaker: Hollow Voice
steps.content: You can't get rid of it... What's trapping you here is your own heart...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No... I don't want these, release me, let me go back and protect him! I don't want to be hindered, I can give up all these emotions!
steps.female_content: No... I don't want these, release me, let me go back and protect her! I don't want to be hindered, I can give up all these emotions!

steps.content: She struggles to escape from the illusory realm, but her efforts are in vain. ${PlayerName}'s suffering keeps upsetting her. Hecate closes her eyes painfully.
At that moment, she hears a voice unheard before.
You don't need to give them up...
Hecate, open your eyes, look at him. This is not an illusion.
steps.female_content: Hecate, open your eyes, look at her. This is not an illusion.

steps.content: The voice is loaded with an irresistible charm. Hecate opens her eyes tremulously and looks at ${PlayerName} who's covered in wounds. The light on his hand is dim, but it hasn't gone out.
steps.female_content: The voice is loaded with an irresistible charm. Hecate opens her eyes tremulously and looks at ${PlayerName} who's covered in wounds. The light on her hand is dim, but it hasn't gone out.

steps.content: He lacked power, but he still insisted on entering this place, and he ventured further even after losing you two. He's made the wrong decision, that's why he keeps collapsing over and over again.
steps.female_content: She lacked power, but she still insisted on entering this place, and she ventured further even after losing you two. She's made the wrong decision, that's why she keeps collapsing over and over again.

steps.content: But he always stands back up and keeps on fighting. Is he useless like this? Is he weak?
steps.female_content: But she always stands back up and keeps on fighting. Is she useless like this? Is she weak?

steps.content: Hecate looks at the figure in the illusory realm. The figure coughs a couple times, struggles, grips the shackles, and stands up to fight the many enemies with everything left.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief is not weak, he's always been... very strong.
steps.female_content: Chief is not weak, she's always been... very strong.

steps.content: Do you know... what's keeping him fighting?
steps.female_content: Do you know... what's keeping her fighting?

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Show CG of Chief embracing Hecate

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This time, it's my turn to protect you...
Is this also... an unnecessary emotion?

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Return

Hecate can no longer hear the voice in the illusion. She's put aside any unnecessary thoughts and lets her body act instinctively. Breaking free from the swamp of darkness and pain, she heads toward where Chief is.

steps.speaker: Hecate's phantoms
steps.content: Stay, you're still carrying unnecessary emotions. It's pointless to go, you'll only...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare! Beat them!
